description: This file defines the class ADODB2_firebird, which implements database schema management and code generation functionalities specifically for the Firebird database system within the ADODB PHP database abstraction library.

classes.name: ADODB2_firebird
classes.description: A class extending ADODB_DataDict providing Firebird-specific database schema management, including data type mapping, quoting identifiers, and creating triggers and generators.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Maps internal metadata types to Firebird SQL data types.

methods.name: NameQuote
methods.description: Quotes database object names according to Firebird syntax rules.

methods.name: CreateDatabase
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to initialize a Firebird database with external functions.

methods.name: _DropAutoIncrement
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop auto-increment generators for tables.

methods.name: _CreateSuffix
methods.description: Creates SQL suffix clauses for column definitions, including defaults and nullability.

methods.name: _Triggers
methods.description: Creates generators and triggers for auto-increment functionality in Firebird.
